name: base44-phone-sso
description: Phone-number login (a one-time code on WhatsApp) for Base44 apps. Self-hosted OIDC provider on Cloudflare + Base44 Advanced/Manual SSO + an in-app allowlist. Delivery through Green API or Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API with automatic failover, an app-domain login page for filtered networks, and automatic user provisioning for public apps.
